reviews.title: Good for NAS
reviews.comment: Worked right out of the box to replace a drive that was having issues in my NAS. Took about 2 days to add this disk to parity on Unraid which has been about the normal for this size and it being a spinner. Packaging was good as I would expect for a new product. ESD bag plus cardboard support around the drive meant no issues when the box was shipped. I didn’t have any problems with spin up sound, though I am running 10 drives in my NAS as a mix of WD red, and Seagate Ironwolf pros.
